stem: An engineer at Harrow Dynamics wants a fast, no-credentials check that a shared module has no misspelled attribute name before opening a pull request. Which command should they run?
rationale: validate checks attribute names and value types against a provider's schema without needing live credentials. fmt only rewrites style across a directory tree and never inspects attribute names. init only installs providers and modules and initializes a backend; skipping the backend does not add any attribute checking. destroy deprovisions real infrastructure and has nothing to do with checking attribute names.
